title: Comparison of Indacaterol 150 mcg Once Daily (o.d.) With Salmeterol/Fluticasone Propionate 50 mcg/500 mcg Twice Daily (b.i.d.)
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to compare the effectiveness and safety of indacaterol with salmeterol /fluticasone propionate treatment in patients with moderate chronic obstructive pulmonary disease who, on entry to the study are being treated with salmeterol /fluticasone propionate.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with moderate COPD (Stage II)
* Able to perform spirometry assessments
* Current or ex-smokers
* On treatment with the fixed-dose combination of salmeterol 50 µg/fluticasone propionate 500 µg MDDPI b.i.d. for the treatment of COPD for ≥ 3 months directly preceding Visit 1.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Having had a COPD exacerbation that required treatment with antibiotics and/or oral corticosteroids and/or hospitalization in the past year.
* Having a history of, or current ECG abnormality
* Asthma

Other protocol-defined inclusion/exclusion criteria may apply.
